card.name: Partway through drug names and USP
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a drug name (teriflunomide, leflunomide, irinotecan, armodafinil, isavuconazonium) or on the US of USP after a product name. The next piece is predictable from the drug name.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, where the rest of the name is still to come.
modes.example: Monitor INR as ter<<if>>lunomide may decrease INR

modes.label: USP after product name
modes.description: The US of USP right after a tablet or capsule product name and comma.
modes.example: triamterene and hydrochlorothiazide capsules,<< US>>P. Surgical Considerations

card.writes: It promotes single letters, which suggests it helps spell out the rest of a word, and it suppresses odd unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long drug name, or the start of USP after a product name, when the rest of the spelling is easy to guess.
